column1: # Compiler.CanonicalResourcePageMaterializer: Objective contract manifest. Written by `scripts/check-objective-proofs.sh proofs --pin`;
# an added, removed, restated, redefined or re-axiomed row needs a line in scripts/gates/objective-contract-decisions.txt.

column8: {K V : Type} → [DecidableEq K] → [inst : Zero V] → [LinearOrder K] → [DecidableEq V] → (Π₀ (x : K), V) → List (K × V)

∀ {K V : Type} [inst : DecidableEq K] [inst_1 : Zero V] [inst_2 : LinearOrder K] [inst_3 : DecidableEq V] (f : Π₀ (x : K), V), Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalResourcePageMaterializer.entries f = List.map (fun key => (key, f key)) (f.support.sort fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2)

∀ {α : Type} (kind : UInt8) (stream : Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.StreamCodec α) {bytes : List UInt8} {value : α}, (Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalResourcePageMaterializer.framedCodec kind stream).decode bytes = Option.some value → (Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalResourcePageMaterializer.framedCodec kind stream).encode value = bytes

∀ {α : Type} (kind : UInt8) (stream : Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.StreamCodec α) (bytes : List UInt8) (value : α), (Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalResourcePageMaterializer.framedCodec kind stream).decode bytes = Option.some value ↔ (Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalResourcePageMaterializer.framedCodec kind stream).encode value = bytes

∀ {α : Type} (kind : UInt8) (stream : Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.StreamCodec α) (value : α), (Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalResourcePageMaterializer.framedCodec kind stream).encode value = Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalResourcePageMaterializer.wireFrame ++ kind :: stream.encode value
{K V : Type} → [DecidableEq K] → [inst : Zero V] → List (K × V) → Π₀ (x : K), V

∀ {K V : Type} [inst : DecidableEq K] [inst_1 : Zero V] [inst_2 : LinearOrder K] [inst_3 : DecidableEq V] (f : Π₀ (x : K), V), Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalResourcePageMaterializer.fromEntries (Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalResourcePageMaterializer.entries f) = f

∀ {K V : Type} [inst : DecidableEq K] [inst_1 : Zero V] (keys : List K) (f : Π₀ (x : K), V) (key : K), (Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalResourcePageMaterializer.fromEntries (List.map (fun k => (k, f k)) keys)) key = if key ∈ keys then f key else 0

∀ {K V : Type} (keyStream : Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.StreamCodec K) (valueStream : Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.StreamCodec V) (items : List ((_ : K) × V)), (Minidregg.Compiler.FiniteDependentMapCodec.entryStream keyStream fun x => valueStream).encodeMany items = (keyStream.product valueStream).encodeMany (List.map (fun entry => (entry.fst, entry.snd)) items)

∀ {K V : Type} [inst : LinearOrder K] [inst_1 : Zero V] [inst_2 : DecidableEq V] (values : Π₀ (x : K), V), (List.map Prod.fst (Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalResourcePageMaterializer.entries values)).Nodup
∀ {K V : Type} [inst : LinearOrder K] [inst_1 : Zero V] [inst_2 : DecidableEq V] (values : Π₀ (x : K), V), ∀ entry ∈ Minidregg.Compiler.CanonicalResourcePageMaterializer.entries values, entry.2 ≠ 0

∀ {K V : Type} (keyStream : Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.StreamCodec K) (valueStream : Minidregg.Compiler.Tower256ConcreteBackend.StreamCodec V) (items : List ((_ : K) × V)), (Minidregg.Compiler.FiniteDependentMapCodec.entryStream keyStream fun x => valueStream).list.encode items = (keyStream.product valueStream).list.encode (List.map (fun entry => (entry.fst, entry.snd)) items)
